plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Public Health, Arnold School of Public Health, Public Health Programs, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_pubh-bs_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (16/17/16/16/12/16/14/14 at slot minimums = 121 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 32 major, 47-56 college/program, 32-41 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Foreign language/other Carolina Core (3-4) at 3; Program Elective 300+ (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Requirement 'only if needed' (0-3) at 0, marked required_zero per the BACKLOG-18 variable-credit convention. 8-9 credit hours of Program Electives (300+, advisor-approved) and a 12-credit-hour Natural Science Cognate (300+, advisor-approved) required; foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 110 course required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
